text: When ~ enters, if you cast him, exile up to one target nonland card of each card type from your graveyard. Copy those cards. You may cast any number of spells with total mana value N or less from among the copies without paying their mana costs.
failing_piece: exile up to one target nonland card of each card type from your graveyard.
note: drilled: explicit target groups "up to one target creature card and up to one target artifact card" compile with "Copy those cards. You may cast the copies" (C6-uld-2); "up to one target [nonland] card of each card type" fails (C6-uld-1, C6-uld-5) and so does "any number of target cards with different card types" (C6-uld-6); Grime Gorger's untargeted "exile up to one card of each card type from defending player's graveyard" compiles: one target group per card type (CR 115.1, 601.2c; a card with two card types fills one group). Second piece: "You may cast any number of spells with total mana value 6 or less from among the copies" fails (C6-uld-3), while "any number of the copies" compiles (C6-uld-8; Arcane Bombardment, Bloodthirsty Adversary) and Invoke Calamity's "up to two ... spells with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard" compiles (C6-uld-9): a total-mana-value cap on casting from among copies (CR 707.12, 707.12a), the same cap construct as Baron Helmut Zemo's "up to three of the copies".

text: Boast — Exile any number of black cards from your graveyard with fifteen or more black mana symbols among their mana costs: Copy those exiled cards. You may cast up to three of the copies without paying their mana costs.
note: drilled: the boast cost with "fifteen or more black mana symbols among their mana costs" compiles now (C6-bz-1; cards5-costs-sets built it), so the first failing piece moved to the effect: "Copy those exiled cards" and "Copy those cards" after the cost fail (C6-bz-2, C6-bz-3), while after an effect's exile they compile (C6-bz-6): the cards exiled by the cost as the copy's referent. Second piece: "You may cast up to three of the copies" fails after the cost and on a neutral card (C6-bz-4, C6-bz-5): a count cap on casting from among copies, the construct of Uldaros Theorix' total-mana-value cap (search "of the copies|from among the copies": Uldaros, Zemo, and the uncapped "any number of the copies" of Arcane Bombardment, Bloodthirsty Adversary, Wizard's Spellbook, The Tale of Tamiyo, which compile).
